visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses and a messy hairstyle, wearing a light blue denim jacket over a white graphic t-shirt and blue jeans, walks along a bright outdoor sidewalk. He looks upwards and around with a distressed expression, gesturing with his hands as if searching for something. (2) He runs frantically through a park-like setting with lush green trees and a paved path. He approaches a row of yellow Ubikes parked in their docks. He reaches into a bike basket and pulls out a smartphone. (3) He holds the smartphone close to the camera, showing a game interface with a 'MapleStory' logo on a white screen. He then begins to dance and move energetically in the park, with a yellow geodesic dome structure visible in the background. (4) The scene shifts to an indoor setting resembling a formal meeting or hearing. One man in a black suit and tie argues with an older-looking man with gray hair, a mustache, and a gray suit. They both have microphones in front of them. The younger man holds a phone showing the game, while the older man also shows a phone with the game running. (5) In a classroom setting, two students (both played by the same man) are seated at wooden desks. One student rests his head on his hand looking bored, while the other student raises his hands to show he is playing the game on a phone sitting on the desk without touching it. (6) Back outdoors on a rubberized playground surface, the man in the denim jacket crouches and solves a Rubik's cube. He then stands up and walks away into the distance, leaving his phone lying on the ground. (7) The camera focuses on the phone on the ground, which displays the game 'MapleStory R: Evolution' and its idle gameplay. The man realizes he left it and runs back toward the camera in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A frantic male voice speaks at a fast rate with high pitch variability, accompanied by low-level urban ambient noise. He sounds anxious about a lost phone. (2) Rapid footsteps and a short metallic 'thud' are heard as he finds the phone. (3) An upbeat, high-tempo Japanese pop jingle with electronic drums and synths swells as he announces playing the game. (4) The audio cuts to a loud, aggressive shouting match between two male voices in a formal setting, with the game's jingle intermittently stingering in. (5) A series of metallic clicking sounds (Rubik's cube) are heard clearly over a quieter background. (6) The high-energy game jingle returns with a female vocal hook as the video closes with the character running again.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Multiple absurdity scenarios -> CTA/Brand Reveal -> Closing Hook.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the idle game 'MapleStory R: Evolution' by showcasing its 'hands-free' or 'idle' progression feature through various humorous and exaggerated life scenarios, including formal debates and puzzle-solving.
